The '''Shador system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] portion<ref name="aoc" /> of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region called [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="slice" /> It contained the planet [[Shador]], homeworld of the [[Shadorian]]s.
